svg.title: Cumulative DAMA knowledge area and FAIRMM level alignment
svg.desc: L1 associations persist through L5. L0 has no positive alignment. Direct and Indirect are separate contribution types.

g.text: 26 onset judgements → 127 cumulative associations. L0 is diagnostic, not positive alignment.
Area presence compounds; scope, implementation and maturity must still be established independently.
